newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tsann Kuen to sell stake in Shanghai unit.
newsitem.headline: Tsann Kuen to sell stake in Shanghai unit.

text.p: Xiamen-based appliance maker Tsann Kuen (China) Enterprise Co Ltd said on Thursday it planned to sell its 75 percent stake in a Shanghai subsidiary.
The firm said in a notice in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times that it planned to sell its entire 75 percent stake in the Shanghai Tsann Kuen Co Ltd for at least US$6.25 million.

A spokeswoman for the Shenzhen-listed firm told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter that most of the stake would be sold to Tsann Kuen Enterprise' chairman Wu Tsann-kuen, a Taiwan-based entrepreneur.
The proposal requires the approval from Tsann Kuen Enterprise shareholders, who will meet in May, she added.
In 1994, Tsann Kuen Enterprise invested US$6.25 million to set up Shanghai Tsann Kuen, which opened last May, she said.
Shanghai Tsann Kuen, which specialises in making household appliances, is expected to have sales of US$12 million this year, she said.
She did not issue a profit forecast. The official said Tsann Kuen Enterprise has forecast 1996 sales of US$104 million.
